cards.label: Camden
cards.text: Two lads corner you near the lock, doing their best impression of menace between a falafel stall and a man selling knock-off headphones. It's not entirely unconvincing.

cards.speaker: One of Them
cards.text: "Toll for using this bit of pavement. Fifty quid, and we all have a nice afternoon."
The third one just stands there, which is somehow worse.

choices.label: Pay £50
choices.result_text: You pay. They seem almost disappointed not to have to do anything. You walk on with your dignity roughly 90% intact.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.result_text: You refuse. For a second, nobody moves — whatever happens next happens fast.

cards.text: Camden closes back over you like nothing happened. Somewhere, a man is still selling headphones that don't work.
